Pengubahan Wang Haram 2001 (Akta 613], Menteri membuat perintah yang

Wang Haram (Pindaan Jadual Kedua) (No. 2) 2005.

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING ACT 2001

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING (AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE)
(No. 2) Order 2005

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 85 of the Anti-Money Laundering
Act 2001 [Act 6/3], the Minister makes the following order:
Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering (Amendment
of Second Schedule) (No. 2) Order 2005.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 20 October 2005.

P.U. (A) 417.                         2936

Amendment of Second Schedule

2. The Anti-Money Laundering Act 2001 is amended in the Second
Schedule—

(a) under the heading "Futures Industry Act 1993 [Act 499]" by inserting
after item 37 the following items:

Offences                         Description*
"137A    Section 52a           Segregation of clients' money and
property
Section 52p           Operation of trust accounts
37c    Section 52E          Application of client's money or
property                              "s

(b) by inserting after the heading "Penal Code [Act 574]" and before
the heading "Securities Industry Act 1983 [Act 280]" the following
heading and items:

Offences                                                  Description*

Securities Commission Act [Act 498]

112A    Section 32B         False or misleading statements
112aB    Section 55          Criminal liability for false
statements, etc. in prospectus          ".
